image_description: Two black assault rifles mounted horizontally on a white slatwall display board. The top rifle appears to be an MP5-style submachine gun with a wire stock and vertical foregrip. The bottom rifle is a bullpup design (resembling a Steyr AUG) with a fixed stock, carrying handle, and translucent magazine. A knife in a sheath and other small accessories are visible below the firearms.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Pistol grips are distinct on both. The bottom rifle has a fixed stock/handguard assembly; the top has a wire stock and distinct foregrip/handguard.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Parkerized or anodized metal with polymer furniture.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Visual texture suggests metal receivers and polymer stocks/grips, consistent with modern firearm manufacturing.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Upper receiver has carrying handle or Picatinny rail for optics.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The bottom rifle features a prominent integrated carrying handle/optic housing. The top rifle has a rail system on top of the receiver.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Distinguishing features include magazine well and ejection port.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Magazine wells are clearly defined. Ejection ports are visible on the right side of the receivers.
